title: Filter Introduction Demos by Incomplete Interactions
description: Stop introduction ghost-cursor demos from replaying completed interactions by filtering effectiveDemonstrations against completedInteractionIndices, using the existing parallel-index authoring contract (demo[i] teaches interaction[i]).
summary: Filtered introduction ghost-cursor demonstrations to only replay incomplete interactions: effectiveDemonstrations now excludes demonstrations[i] when completedInteractionIndices includes i (parallel-index contract demo[i] teaches interaction[i]). Gallery steps with no interactions are unchanged. Documented the contract on IntroductionStepDefinition.demonstrations in Rust. Added vitest coverage for partial completion, full completion, and gallery steps. All 9 UIIntroduction demonstration tests pass.
